method: 26 self-contained probe .abc files converted with `python3 abc2xml/abc2xml.py -o xml <file>`; XML inspected with xml.etree via inspect_probes.py (element counts, attribute-order-independent).

features.evidence: 1 <clef> sign=G line=2; pitches C4..C5 unshifted.
1 <clef> sign=F line=4; pitches C3..C4 unshifted (ABC pitch is absolute).
1 <clef> sign=C line=3.
1 <clef> sign=C line=4.

features.syntax: V:1 clef=soprano (standard ABC name) — not recognised; house name alto1 works
features.evidence: P1 (clef=soprano): 0 <clef> elements emitted, silently ignored; P2 (clef=alto1): <clef> sign=C line=1.
features.proposal: Add 'soprano' -> ('C','1') and 'mezzosoprano' -> ('C','2') to clefMap and to the clef-name regex in doClef (aliases of the existing alto1/alto2), matching standard ABC 2.1 clef names.

features.evidence: 1 <clef> sign=percussion (no line); all 7 notes emitted as <unpitched>.
<clef> sign=TAB line=5; <staff-details> staff-lines=6 with 6 <staff-tuning> E2 A2 D3 G3 B3 E4 (default guitar).

features.feature: clef treble-8 with correct sounding octave
features.evidence: <clef> G/2 with <clef-octave-change>-1</clef-octave-change>; ABC c..c' emitted as sounding C4..C5 (written-pitch shifted down 1 octave, correct MusicXML semantics).

features.feature: clef treble+8 with correct sounding octave
features.evidence: <clef-octave-change>1</clef-octave-change>; ABC C..c emitted as sounding C5..C6.

features.feature: clef bass-8 with correct sounding octave
features.evidence: <clef> F/4 with octave-change -1; ABC C,..C emitted as sounding C2..C3. Note: display-only variant clef=treble_8 emits octave-change -1 with UNshifted pitches C5..C6 (abc2xml convention: +/- shift playback, ^/_ display only).

features.syntax: V:1 clef=none — accepted but emits nothing; MusicXML <sign>none</sign> unreachable
features.evidence: 0 <clef> elements in output; doClef maps 'none' to ('','') and returns before emitting.
features.proposal: Map 'none' to sign 'none' (clefMap 'none':('none','')) so MusicXML <clef><sign>none</sign></clef> is emitted and MuseScore hides the clef.

features.evidence: 4 <key> elements with fifths 7, -7, -1, 1; implied alters applied to notes (C#4.. under K:C#, Gb4.. under K:Cb).
fifths/mode = 0/dorian, 0/mixolydian, 5/lydian, 0/minor — all correct.
K:Aaeolian emits fifths=3 mode=major (should be fifths=0 mode=aeolian) and sharpens sounding pitches (C#5 in output); K:Cionian emits mode=major (fifths 0 correct only by coincidence of C).
features.cause: offTab/modTab lack 'aeo' and 'ion'; unknown modes silently fall back to 'maj'.
features.proposal: Add 'aeo':11,'ion':8 to offTab and 'aeo':'aeolian','ion':'ionian' to modTab.

features.evidence: Emits <key> fifths=0 mode=major (standard MusicXML representation of an empty signature); no spurious note alterations.

<key> gets correct key-step/key-alter pairs (B/-1, F/1) and notes inherit the alterations, BUT the emitted <key-octave> elements are malformed: <key-octave number="5"/> — empty content and the octave stored in the number attribute; per MusicXML, number must be the 1-based index of the key-step and the octave goes in the element text.
features.proposal: Emit <key-octave number="i">oct</key-octave> with i = position of the key-step (1-based), text = octave; or drop key-octave entirely when octaves are default.

features.evidence: Emits 4 key-steps [B-1, C+1, E-1, F+1]: the 'exp' keyword is ignored, so the D-major signature (F#, C#) leaks through and the listed flats are merely added; ABC 2.1 'exp' means ONLY the listed accidentals (expected exactly B-1, E-1).
features.proposal: When the mode token is 'exp', clear s.keyAlts before applying the listed alterations.

features.evidence: <time> beats=4 beat-type=4 with NO symbol attribute — the C glyph is lost (MuseScore shows numeric 4/4). MusicXML expects <time symbol="common">.
features.proposal: In doFields, keep a flag when field was 'C'/'C|' and set t.set('symbol','common'/'cut').

features.evidence: <time> beats=2 beat-type=2 with NO symbol attribute — the cut-time glyph is lost; should carry symbol="cut".
Two <time> elements beats/beat-type 5/8 and 7/8; measure durations accepted without warnings.
<time> beats='3+2' beat-type=8 (valid MusicXML additive beats text); 5-quaver measures accepted.
<accidental> sharp/flat/natural with alter 1/-1/0.
alter=2 (correct pitch) but <accidental>sharp-sharp</accidental> — the two-vertical-sharps glyph, not the conventional x-shaped 𝄪; canonical MusicXML value is 'double-sharp'.
alter=-2 with <accidental>flat-flat</accidental> — 'flat-flat' IS the canonical MusicXML value for 𝄫.
2 <accidental parentheses="yes"> elements (natural, sharp). NOTE: !courtesy! is implemented (mkNote line ~1233) but undocumented in FEATURES.md.

features.syntax: none reaches the converter — standard ABC 2.1 ^/C, _/D, ^3/2E all rejected
features.evidence: 8 'misplaced symbol' warnings; all notes emitted as plain unaltered pitches (0 <accidental>, 0 alter) — the microtone intent is silently discarded from the score. Grammar accidental = oneOf('^^ __ ^ _ =') only; docs declare no microtone syntax.
features.proposal: Support ABC 2.1 fractional accidentals ^/C (alter 0.5, <accidental>quarter-sharp</accidental>), _/C (-0.5, quarter-flat), ^3/2C (1.5, three-quarters-sharp), _3/2C (-1.5, three-quarters-flat).

features.feature: noteheads on pitched notes (x, diamond, slash, triangle, none, circle-x)
features.syntax: none exists for pitched notes; <notehead> is reachable only via I:percmap / drummap on percussion voices
features.evidence: !diamond! !x! !slash! on 3 notes produce 0 <notehead> elements and 21 <other-articulation> elements: each unknown decoration is re-emitted on EVERY later note (note1 gets [diamond], note2 [diamond,x], note3..8 [diamond,x,slash]) — the same sticky-decoration defect class as D31.
features.proposal: Add a decoration family !head=x! / !head=diamond! / !head=slash! / !head=triangle! / !head=none! / !head=circle-x! (optionally trailing + / - for filled yes/no, mirroring the percmap convention) mapped to <notehead>; and clear s.nextdecos of consumed/unknown tokens so they cannot leak onto later notes.

features.evidence: 7 <unpitched> notes D4..C5 with <notehead> x, circle-x, diamond, triangle, slash, none, normal[filled=yes] ('normal+' suffix works); 7 distinct <instrument> refs with score-part <midi-unpitched> = GM number + 1 (correct 1-based MusicXML).

features.syntax: K:C clef=perc, then plain notes; ^ gives x head, _ gives circle-x
features.evidence: 7 <unpitched> notes; noteheads normal/x/circle-x auto-assigned from accidental; midi-unpitched 72/74/76 auto-derived from staff position.
<staff-details><staff-lines>1</staff-lines> on the perc voice and staff-lines=4 on the treble voice.
<transpose><chromatic>-2</chromatic> and <chromatic>3</chromatic> inside <attributes>; written pitches unchanged (correct MusicXML written+transpose semantics). <diatonic> not emitted (optional).
<transpose><chromatic>-12</chromatic> emitted in the first measure's <attributes>.
